name: @avatark/motion
description: Shared motion primitives: pure SVG path-length math (pathLength), and the four real client components (PageEnter, RevealOnView, RippleLink, DepartureLink) products can inherit. CSS keyframes/utility classes remain in each app's own stylesheet this phase -- not yet centralized.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
